snippet.title: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Ready your detective hats for the Official Launch Trailer of MOUSE: P.I. For Hire, the black and white first-person shooter by Fumi Games and PlaySide Studios.

Launching April 16, 2026 across PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Wishlist now!
